name: light A (subtle)
about: The light pass (issue #318, Sean 2026-10-23: 'looks too cheap', 'the day time outside looks the worst'): harsh noon with deep shade, the ground exposed down, a paler hazy sky with rounder clouds, distance haze; the street a dusty grey-tan; a grade (cool shade, warm light, the oranges pulled back); contact shadows in the sun; grain, vignette, heat shimmer; the saloon at night in pools of lamplight with dark between and the moon in the door. Switched on 8 (LightLooks).
